what: Clicking a link draws a blue line in .3s along the path on the map (or from the clicked spot if there is none). At its end a round plate grows in .38s until it covers the screen, then moves on to the next page. On the next page the covering plate shrinks in .4s into the here marker (land spot) and the screen opens.
ease: Line power1.inOut · grow power3.in · shrink power3.inOut · blur .16s in the meantime

options.route: Selector for the svg path to trace — the first path whose start and end are both visible on screen. If none, the path inside the link, and if that is missing too, the right end of the link
options.fade: Selector to fade to .2 during the transition
options.draw: Line length (seconds), default .3 (.18 at width 1023 or below)
options.grow: Grow duration (seconds), default .38 (.28 at widths 1023 and below)
options.shrink: Shrink duration (seconds), default .4 (.3 at width 1023 or less)
options.land: If true, this element is the landing spot — on a page arriving via this part, the panel shrinks down into here

use: View case · Next page: Here

from.where: shared.js case study link ([data-warp]) transition and works.html arrival (shrinks to the end of .g-aerial__route)

note: Before navigating, a flag is left in sessionStorage so the arriving page starts covered (same tab). The panel covers 2.5 times the screen diagonal. With reduced motion or a new tab (⌘·Ctrl held) it just navigates.
